parameters.description:
Only returns resources processed by the public API after the date-time provided.

Uses the date-time format specified in [RFC 3339 section 5.6, Internet Date/Time Format](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6). 

The value cannot contain spaces, and date and time should be separated by "T". 

For example:
* UTC time "2023-05-01T00:00:00Z".
* An offset from UTC time to indicate a time zone, such as "2023-05-01T00:00:00%2B08:00" (for 8 hours ahead of UTC time). 

Note that query parameters should be properly escaped, last example is equivalent to "2023-05-01T00:00:00+08:00".

culture_amp_new_employee_trigger.description: Runs for each new employee in Culture Amp. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

culture_amp_new_manager_review_trigger.description: Runs for each new manager review in Culture Amp. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

culture_amp_new_or_updated_employee_trig.description: Runs for each employee added or changed in Culture Amp. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

culture_amp_new_or_updated_manager_revie.description: Runs for each manager review added or changed in Culture Amp. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

culture_amp_new_or_updated_performance_c.description: Runs for each performance cycle added or changed in Culture Amp. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

culture_amp_new_performance_cycle_trigge.description: Runs for each new performance cycle in Culture Amp. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
